sourceContract: Grok sessions/<cwd>/<session>/usage.json: session, turns[].modelUsage, primaryModelId, usageIsIncomplete. Same envelope as grok usage <session-id>; field semantics observed. Synthetic values.

scenarios.name: a single-model turn allocates every counter without adding cache or reasoning again
a multi-model turn splits by its rows, not by its primary label
session rows are never added to turn rows or used as allocation evidence
rows shaped like a cumulative stream fail per-turn reconciliation
one wrong per-model cache field moves the whole turn to unallocated
a model-call mismatch also refuses the split
a row that adds cache and reasoning into its total is refused
a row missing a counter is not an allocation
rows whose sums match but whose own totals are wrong are refused
more rows than the per-record cap are refused whole
a primary label with empty rows stays unknown
a turn that reached no model has nothing to allocate
a primary label with no row is ignored when the rows reconcile
one unusable row label refuses the whole turn and is never copied
a turn failing every check is named by its label first
a malformed row that also misses the sum is named as malformed
a turn flagged incomplete reconciles as a marked lower bound
cost ticks do not reconcile and never enter a model bucket
copied snapshots with reversed row order count once
two different splits of identical totals are a conflict with no winner
a reconciling copy and a mismatched copy are a conflict in either order
a copy without rows adds nothing beside a reconciling copy
contradictory counter copies are refused and their rows unused
a snapshot whose session total disagrees refuses its turns despite clean rows
an undated turn travels as a provider tombstone and stays refused
an old report alone cannot carry a model
an old copy adds no evidence and no tokens beside a reconciling new copy
a new copy with no rows reports missing, not lost capability
